shopify.sales.description: Reads this stream's Shopify merch counter: paid orders, minus cancellations and refunds. Test events never count. No API needed.
shopify.sales.returns: revenue, orders, items, refunded, currency, since (when the counter started) and products (product name to how many sold).

shopify.resetSales.description: Starts the Shopify merch counter and goal again from zero.
shopify.resetSales.returns: The counter after the reset (like shopify.sales).

shopify.goal.description: Reads the Shopify merch goal set on the Webhooks page.
shopify.goal.returns: title, measure ("Items sold" or "Revenue"), current, target, percent, currency and reached.

shopify.setGoal.description: Changes the Shopify merch goal. Leave out anything you want to keep.

parameters.title: Optional. The goal's new name.
parameters.target: Optional. The new target; 0 turns the goal off.

shopify.setGoal.returns: The goal after the change (like shopify.goal).

shopify.products.description: Lists your Shopify products from the last refresh. Needs the Shopify API connected on the Webhooks page.

parameters.search: Optional. Only products whose name contains this.

shopify.products.returns: A list of products with name, price, formattedPrice, currency, url, image, soldOut and stock.

shopify.totals.description: Reads your paid Shopify orders over the last hours from Shopify itself (cancelled and test orders left out). Needs the Shopify API connected.
shopify.totals.returns: revenue, orders, items, currency and since.
